profile.name: Shivam Verma
profile.title: Android & iOS Developer
profile.intro: I build native Android and iOS apps, from the first screen to the store release. 4+ years, 25+ production apps, and a 20% revenue lift from ads and in-app purchases.
profile.availability: Open to Android and iOS developer roles

apps.name: AI Cleaner
apps.summary: Finds blurry photos, duplicate screenshots and redundant contacts so people can free up storage in a few taps.
details: Built an iOS utility app using OpenCV to detect blurry photos, duplicate screenshots and redundant contacts.
Added features to review and delete unwanted media, freeing up device storage and improving performance.

apps.name: Kid Safe
apps.summary: Lets parents set limits on a child's phone and monitor usage across devices, with real-time alerts.
details: Built a parental control app that lets parents limit and monitor a child's phone usage across multiple devices.
Implemented real-time alerts and app usage tracking logs for complete device monitoring.

apps.name: Medicine & Health Reminder
apps.summary: Medicine reminders with BP tracking and health checks, plus simple flows to log readings and schedule doses.
details: Developed a health utility app with medicine reminders, BP tracking and health check features.
Implemented user-friendly flows to record health information and schedule reminders.

apps.name: Save Status
apps.summary: Download statuses and edit images for 4 major social media platforms.
details: Developed a media download and image editing app supporting 4 major social media platforms.
Optimized file handling and local storage for smooth memory management during media processing.

apps.name: Doc Reader
apps.summary: Pick any document, then duplicate, split, lock or unlock PDFs, or save pages as images.
details: Built a document utility app that lets users pick documents and perform multiple PDF operations.
Implemented duplicating, splitting and locking/unlocking PDFs, and saving PDF pages as images.

apps.name: Asset First
apps.summary: Inventory management for companies using RFID tags and Bluetooth-connected scanners.
details: Developed an Android app that helps companies manage their inventory using RFID tags and external scanners.
Integrated external RFID scanners to read tags and save asset data reliably through REST APIs.
apps.note: Built for a client, not on public app stores.

apps.name: Attendance Management
apps.summary: Employee attendance with NFC tags and readers, with records stored on the device.
details: Developed an Android app that efficiently handles employee attendance using NFC tags and readers.
Stored attendance records locally using Room (SQLite) database.
apps.note: Built for a client, not on public app stores.

points: Worked on 18 native Android and iOS apps and led projects from scratch to production with junior and senior developers.
Increased app revenue by 20% with new monetization strategies, ads and In-App Purchase scenarios.
Drove product discussions, new app ideas and app flows from concept to launch.
Built and deployed 7+ Android and Flutter apps for enterprise clients, including RFID devices connected over BLE.
Resolved 12 critical production issues, improving app stability.
